import re
from collections import Counter


def top_n_words(text, n):
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z']+", text.lower())
    counts = Counter(words)
    ordered = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    return [word for word, _ in ordered[:n]]
